Frequently asked questions

What's included in the 2-day price?

The written quote identifies the transportation dates, service windows, and assigned vehicle. Guests book and pay hotels, meals, Navajo tours, boats, admissions, and activities directly unless that quote expressly includes a listed item.

Where do we stay overnight?

Choose and book lodging directly based on current availability, policies, and budget. Send the confirmed hotel and check-in time so it can be added to the transportation schedule.

Can we customize the itinerary?

Submit confirmed activities and check-in times for review. Any boat, kayak, slot-canyon, or Navajo tour must be booked and paid directly unless the written quote expressly includes it.

Which Lake Powell access point should we use?

The National Park Service identifies multiple Glen Canyon access points, and lake levels and current conditions can affect access and operations. Confirm the exact Page, Wahweap, or Antelope Point endpoint and review current conditions before submitting the route.
